title: Stable influence lower bound
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$, and suppose its variance is positive. Then three times its variance, multiplied by $(1/3)^{I/\operatorname{Var}(f)}$, is at most its total stable influence at parameter $1/3$, where $I$ denotes its total influence.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
